currentParagraphText: “Seems like she’s done,” the Sword Saint said. “She must have spent a fair deal of mana, considering she took down six groups in a row.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I’m not so sure, she fought a lot using her Authority of Wind,” Dina said, clearly fully on board with no longer teasing one another. “I would guess she did the same in her other fights.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Sylphie looked quite proud of herself as she puffed out her chest. The five defeated members of the Pantheon of Life picked themselves up and respectfully bowed to the mighty hawk before leaving to lick their wounds.
